blocks.text: SAN FERNANDO, BUKIDNON, Philippines — Over 300 indigenous learners in a remote village here now have access to modern education after officials energized the Salumayag Tigwahanon Integrated School under the national government’s Last Mile Schools Electrification Program on Friday, Oct. 23, 2026.
